tools.name: get_connection
tools.description: Check the Sloosh connection, spending status and the daily allowance left. Call once at the start of a conversation.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read a Sloosh guide by id: connection, spending, assets, generation, spaces, recovery, release-status.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List assets already in the Sloosh workspace.

tools.name: import_asset
tools.description: Import an image, video or audio file from any public HTTPS URL and register it in the workspace library. Returns the asset kind and id.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Resolve a typed workspace or generated asset reference and its current URL.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Discover available models. Pass type speech for the speech models, their premade voices and languages, and whether each speaks the workspace's own voices (customVoices).

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List the workspace's own cloned voices. A voice whose status is pending_verification can't speak yet.

tools.name: quote_generation
tools.description: Quote image generation, video generation, video editing or speech. For speech, use mode speech_gen with the script as prompt (spoken word for word) and modelConfig.voice or modelConfig.voiceAssetId. Free. Returns a quoteId and its credits.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Start a paid generation for a quote. Needs quoteId, a stable idempotencyKey and confirmed=true after the user approves the quote.

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Get the status and outputs of a generation.
